title.narrative: Central Asian Technical Assistance Framework for implementation support of EBRD Municipal and Environmental Infrastructure Projects-extension

description.narrative: The TA funded under IFCA will cover both the water sector and the solid waste sector in the Kyrgyz Republic as well as in Tajikistan. The overall objective is to respond to the significant needs of municipal services in the beneficiary countries, notably in the areas of water supply, wastewater treatment and solid waste management. the TA component funded under IFCA is expected to enhance the quality of the investments and thus, contribute to their long-term sustainability.

title.narrative: Annual reduction in tonnes of C02 equivalent

description.narrative: Annual reduction in tonnes of C02 equivalent

comment.narrative: Baseline value is not defined with the presentation of the indicator in the paragraph 5. EXPECTED RESULTS of the DESCRIPTION OF THE ACTION of the Delegation Agreement ACA2016378602. As a Benchmark at the beginning of the project it is noted that Currently C02 emissions are at the maximum level and the volumes vary from one case to another. It is assumed that the baseline at the beginning of the intervention is zero i.e. no reduction of C02 equivalent.
Final Target is defined as Lower C02 emissions by 45 on average with the presentation of the Projected changes at the end of implementation

title.narrative: Percentage of potable water produced

description.narrative: Percentage of potable water produced

comment.narrative: Baseline value is defined as 59 Current level of technical water losses with the presentation of the indicator in the paragraph 5. EXPECTED RESULTS of the DESCRIPTION OF THE ACTION of the Delegation Agreement ACA2016378602. It is thus assumed that percentage of potable water produced is 41 i.e. 10059.

Final Target is not defined with the presentation of the indicator in the paragraph 5. EXPECTED RESULTS of the DESCRIPTION OF THE ACTION of the Delegation Agreement ACA2016378602. Projected changes at the end of implementation are formulated as Reduce water losses by 25 on average. It is thus assumed that percentage of potable water produced is expected to be 66 i.e. 100 5925. Sexdisaggregation is not relevant.
